dimensions.assessment: Directly affects IRS employees who determine penalties, their immediate supervisors, and taxpayers who receive penalty notices.
dimensions.evidence: No penalty under this title shall be assessed or entered unless, before any written communication with respect to such penalty... is sent to the taxpayer

dimensions.assessment: Changes administrative procedures for penalty approval within the tax assessment process.
dimensions.evidence: the initial determination of such assessment is personally approved (in writing) by the immediate supervisor

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending or revenue changes are stated or clearly implied beyond administrative procedural updates.
Amends specific sections of the Internal Revenue Code regarding penalty assessments.
dimensions.evidence: Section 6751(b)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change affecting notices and penalties issued after December 31, 2025.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to notices issued, and penalties assessed, after December 31, 2025.

missing_information: Specific estimates of the number of taxpayers or IRS employees affected annually.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill updates procedural requirements for IRS supervisors approving tax penalties, directly affecting IRS employees and taxpayers receiving notices of tax penalties.
